name: GDG Lagos
how_to_post: Use the Contact organizers button on the GDG chapter page to propose a talk or event; check the Upcoming events section first.

name: GDG Nairobi
how_to_post: Contact the organizing team via the GDG chapter page to request a slot for a talk or community announcement.

name: GDG Accra
how_to_post: Contact the organizers through the GDG chapter page; events run at least monthly at innovation hubs in Accra.

name: GDG Johannesburg
how_to_post: Use the GDG chapter page to contact the organizers and propose a meetup talk.

name: GDG on Campus - Technical University of Kenya
how_to_post: Use the Contact team button on the GDG on Campus page to pitch a student workshop.

name: Nairobi JavaScript Community
how_to_post: Post in the Telegram group https://telegram.me/nairobijs or message the Meetup organizers to give a talk at the monthly meetup.

name: Africoders
how_to_post: Join the community Discord via the website and post in the relevant build or opportunities channel.

name: Techbuild Africa Community
how_to_post: Join the Telegram group and share a short launch announcement in the group chat.

name: Africa's Talking Community
how_to_post: Create a topic in the community forum and post the announcement there.

name: ZATech
how_to_post: Request a Slack invite by email then post in #announcements-community using the Announce your Event workflow.

name: ECYBER Community
how_to_post: Contact the team at contact@ecybered.com or post in the community Telegram and Discord channels.

name: Localhost - Cloud / DevOps / SRE Community
how_to_post: Join the Slack and Telegram chats from the site and ask the admins before posting a community announcement.

name: freeCodeCamp Lagos
how_to_post: Post in the Facebook group and ask the admins to pin the announcement.

name: freeCodeCamp Abuja
how_to_post: Post in the Facebook group and share in the freeCodeCamp Abuja WhatsApp group with admin approval.

name: freeCodeCamp Kenya
how_to_post: Message the Meetup organizer to propose a session and announce it on the Meetup page.

name: DevC Lagos (Facebook Developer Circles)
how_to_post: Post in the Facebook Developer Circles Lagos group and coordinate with the circle leads.

name: DevC Nairobi (Facebook Developer Circles)
how_to_post: Post in the Facebook group and message the leads to request an event slot.

name: DevC Yaounde
how_to_post: Post in the Facebook group in French or English and tag the circle leads.

name: DevC Algiers
how_to_post: Post in the Facebook group and coordinate with the local leads for meetups.

name: DevC Tunis
how_to_post: Post in the Facebook group and ask the leads to share it with members.
